text:
harper: opened PR adding a short airgapped appendix: conn-checker snippet, HSM/KMS port notes, offline bundle checksum example. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5201

samir: quick read. HSM ports - vendor matrix varies. recommend document 5698/tcp as required; 5699/tcp as optional admin. mark that 5699 is often behind an ACL.

asha: tiny nit on wording: use "allowlist" and avoid "allow all egress". recommend exact domains for installer downloads e.g. rdw-inference-updates.redwood.ai:443 and registry.redwood.ai:443 when public images are used.

harper: updated to allowlist language and added both ports with optional flag. also included a kube Service example and a bare-metal nftables snippet.

docs-bot: Lint: OK. Broken links: 0. CI: queued.

samir: airgap caveats: call out SELinux extract issues on RHEL/CentOS (run `restorecon -R /opt/offline-bundles` after extract) and a path-length note (some filesystems fail >256 chars). include example `/opt/offline/redwood-2026-06.tar.gz`.

harper: added SELinux note and path-length example. also included a 5-line conn-checker that verifies TCP, TLS cert chain, and the local health endpoint: `nc -zv registry.internal:443 && openssl s_client -connect registry.internal:443 -servername registry.internal < /dev/null | grep "Verify return code: 0" && curl -sSf http://localhost:8080/health`

asha: can someone run a quick smoke on semi-airgapped staging (mirror + internal registry) and paste the tiny logs here? would be good to show a passing example.

samir: ran on ubuntu-22, installer v0.12.6:
[2026-06-10T04:02:10Z] fetch mirror -> 200
[2026-06-10T04:02:14Z] verify sha256 -> OK
[2026-06-10T04:02:26Z] extract -> OK
[2026-06-10T04:02:40Z] kms -> connected
[2026-06-10T04:02:45Z] hsm handshake -> OK
[2026-06-10T04:02:52Z] health -> http://localhost:8080/health -> 200
SMOKE: PASS

samir: note: first attempt to registry returned 502, retried and succeeded. added a doc bullet to retry downloads up to 3 times.

harper: great, merging after CI green. filing follow-up issue to add annotated conn-checker screenshots and an expanded troubleshooting section. cc @asha for wording verification.
